author: kycrafft
body:
http://imgur.com/a/fihIA

I think there may be one irrelevenat picture in there.

Keep in mind he was doing this across 3 games and would only stop when a mod came in every once in a while. I tried to report him in game. He also had 2 friends who were calling out "noob" or "rekt" EVERY time I died, no matter who killed me. These are only screenshots of less then half the times they were calling out rekt.

I hope this is enough to give him a tempban, as this made my gaming experience aggrivating, since people hopped on the bandwagon and kept saying 'rekt' when I died.
